ai_summary: **Executive Summary**  Asian Hotels (East) Limited's promoter, Ms. Ratna Saraf, reported an off-market transfer of 2,026,520 equity shares (11.72% stake) by way of a gift to her son. This transaction, which had a nil monetary value, effectively halved her direct shareholding from 23.44% to 11.72%, representing a significant ownership shift within the promoter group. As an internal family transfer complying with SEBI regulations, there are no immediate red flags concerning market confidence or insider trading violations.
